rules: If you try contacting for LOR except this method, your LOR will be revoked even if you're qualified for it. The only way for getting a LOR is applying through this channel.
You must be an active or former member of LCB to be eligible for a Letter of Recommendation.
Submitting false or misleading information will result in immediate disqualification and permanent ineligibility.
LOR requests are reviewed on a case-by-case basis and approval is not guaranteed.
Processing may take up to 7–14 business days after a complete submission.
LCB reserves the right to revoke any issued LOR if misconduct or dishonesty is discovered at any point.
